# free-exercise-db

`exercises.json` is copied unchanged from
[yuhonas/free-exercise-db](https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db) at commit
`f00c92c7dcf1216a928a52c3706c7ce8e2f71ed5` (`dist/exercises.json`): 876 exercises with
muscles, equipment, force, mechanic and instructions. The dataset is released into the
public domain under the [Unlicense](https://unlicense.org).

Images are not copied. Their provenance is unverified (decision #14), so the app ships
exercises as text until that is checked.

To update, replace the file from a newer commit, record the hash here, and rebuild the
library resource.
